name: SLOW
source:
For one year the snow fell in the village of Dragonsgaad.
The village had a legend of once forbidden love between human and dragon.

This is the love story of part-time hot springs protagonist Kanata.

Join him and childhood friend Sumino, wicked companion Meiko, and
mysterious mountain girl Shigure.

-----One day, Kanata had a strange dream.

Experience an inspired adventure spanning time and legend,
tragedy and beautiful love, through the ever-falling snow.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ075680.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
龙神村的雪整整下了一年。
村中流传着一个传说，讲述人类与龙之间曾遭禁忌的爱情。

这是在温泉旅馆打工的主人公出云彼方的爱情故事。

与他同行的有青梅竹马雪月澄乃、损友橘芽依子，
以及神秘的山中少女北里时雨。

——一天，彼方做了一个怪梦。

在永不停歇的飞雪中，亲历一场横跨时间与传说、
悲剧与美丽爱情的奇幻冒险。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ075680.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
